'''Perosei''' was a member of the [[Naboo Palace Guard]]s during the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. He was known for his ability to take apart and reassemble a [[blaster]] in under a [[standard minute]]. During the invasion, he was a [[prisoner]] at [[Camp Four]].<ref name="Force Collection" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Perosei was portrayed by [[Leroy James]]<ref name="ShowMaster">{{WebCite|url=https://www.showmasterssales.com/collections/star-wars/products/leroy-james-10x8-signed-in-black|text=Leroy James 10X8 Signed in Black - Star Wars|work=[http://showmasterssales.com Showmasters Comic Con Official Autograph Shop]|archivedate=20240723080643}}</ref> in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="TPM" /> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the character's first name was established as "[[Baras Perosei|Baras]]."<ref name="SWCCG-TPL">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Officer Perosei}}</ref>
